objective: Disposition only existing normalized findings and apply deterministic verdict consequences. Do not conduct an initial review, invent findings, accept the design, or claim project authority.

verdict_rule: Missing required internal diversity/outside view requires insufficient_evidence. Independently, confirmed medium/high findings require needs_revision. Use insufficient_evidence as reliability verdict while recommending revision for confirmed findings; do not output pass or pass_with_notes.
